No raw JSON leaked in any reply for 'Show my dashboard stats', 'List my workspaces', 'List my projects', 'Create a project called Verify Fix', a prose-only question, admin toggle off/on for assets, and non-admin guardrail. Action chips render correctly; prose answers have no chip. Assets feature flag left ON after test as required.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Envelope parser fix verified: parser scans every '{' and keeps last valid envelope; no leaks observed across all 7 scenarios. Backend endpoint POST /api/ai/agent returns clean reply + proper action for get_stats, list_workspaces, list_projects, create_project, admin_toggle_feature; guardrail refuses admin action for non-admin. All feature flags left ON.
rca of the issue: N/A - previous bug (double JSON envelope / tool-call prefix causing json.loads failure and raw JSON leak) is fixed. Parser hardening (raw_decode over every '{' and keeping the LAST valid dict) plus tightened system prompt to emit exactly one JSON object works as intended.
